# Response Figure 1.3 (ver4): facts for the caption and the text (generated by pathcount_facts.py)

- Figure file `fig_R1.3_pathcount.png`: 4251 x 1104 px at 300 dpi (ver3 image: 4251 x 1322 px, six rows). x-range of all four panels of a: 0.575–0.925. Colour scale of b: symmetric, −0.150 to +0.150 (ver3: ±0.5).
- Truth: 2,443 chr1 somatic SNVs of COLO829T in the benchmark regions, identical in all 16 call sets.

## Deltas, with (seed 0) − without

- ΔP: Illumina v2.1 +0.116; Illumina v1.1 +0.136; Fiber-seq v2.1 −0.007; Fiber-seq v1.1 +0.032. Positive in 3 of 4.
- ΔR: Illumina v2.1 −0.001; Illumina v1.1 −0.001; Fiber-seq v2.1 +0.009; Fiber-seq v1.1 −0.006. Positive in 1 of 4.
- ΔF1: Illumina v2.1 +0.061; Illumina v1.1 +0.079; Fiber-seq v2.1 +0.001; Fiber-seq v1.1 +0.012. Positive in 4 of 4.
- ΔF1 pre: Illumina v2.1 +0.062; Illumina v1.1 +0.082; Fiber-seq v2.1 +0.002; Fiber-seq v1.1 +0.012. Positive in 4 of 4.

## Without the channel against the three seeds with it

- Illumina HPRC v2.1: F1 with the channel 0.797 / 0.725 / 0.816 (seeds 0 / 1 / 2; range 0.091, mean 0.779), without 0.735: inside the seed range; seeds with higher F1 than the model without: 2 of 3 (precision 2 of 3, recall 2 of 3); mean of 3 seeds − without = +0.044.
- Illumina HPRC v1.1: F1 with the channel 0.774 / 0.714 / 0.722 (seeds 0 / 1 / 2; range 0.060, mean 0.736), without 0.694: below the seed range (lowest seed − without = +0.020); seeds with higher F1 than the model without: 3 of 3 (precision 3 of 3, recall 0 of 3); mean of 3 seeds − without = +0.042.
- Fiber-seq HPRC v2.1: F1 with the channel 0.818 / 0.820 / 0.823 (seeds 0 / 1 / 2; range 0.005, mean 0.820), without 0.816: below the seed range (lowest seed − without = +0.001); seeds with higher F1 than the model without: 3 of 3 (precision 0 of 3, recall 3 of 3); mean of 3 seeds − without = +0.004.
- Fiber-seq HPRC v1.1: F1 with the channel 0.819 / 0.819 / 0.825 (seeds 0 / 1 / 2; range 0.006, mean 0.821), without 0.806: below the seed range (lowest seed − without = +0.012); seeds with higher F1 than the model without: 3 of 3 (precision 3 of 3, recall 0 of 3); mean of 3 seeds − without = +0.014.
- Over the four datasets, 11 of 12 with-channel seeds have a higher F1 after the filter than the model without the channel.

## Where the difference comes from (PASS calls after the filter, seed 0 with / without)

- Illumina HPRC v2.1: TP 1,933 / 1,936, FP 476 / 886 (without / with = 1.86x), precision 0.802 / 0.686, recall 0.791 / 0.792.
- Illumina HPRC v1.1: TP 1,955 / 1,958, FP 656 / 1,240 (without / with = 1.89x), precision 0.749 / 0.612, recall 0.800 / 0.801.
- Fiber-seq HPRC v2.1: TP 1,920 / 1,899, FP 334 / 311 (without / with = 0.93x), precision 0.852 / 0.859, recall 0.786 / 0.777.
- Fiber-seq HPRC v1.1: TP 1,926 / 1,940, FP 336 / 428 (without / with = 1.27x), precision 0.851 / 0.819, recall 0.788 / 0.794.

## Before against after the population filter

- |F1 before − F1 after| over the 16 models: largest 0.0023 (COLO829T Illumina, HPRC v1.1, with_s1), so the "F1 (pre-filter)" panel repeats the F1 panel: these models take the population site features as an input.
- The filter removes 1–32 FP and 2–18 TP per call set.

## Pixel check of the PNG

- The centre of the orange diamond of each of the 16 row x panel cells, read back from the PNG and converted to the axis scale, equals the tabulated value of the model without the channel within 0.0006 (one pixel = 0.0006).
